candidate_seeds.name: Stealth SUSY stop/gluino topologies with low MET and many jets (HL-LHC reach)
candidate_seeds.framework: Stealth supersymmetry in natural SUSY (R-parity conserved, soft-gravitino/singlino stealth sector)
candidate_seeds.idea: Stealth sectors give nearly degenerate fermion/boson pairs so that the MET is small and jets+resonances dominate. Simplified models of stealth stops/gluinos with singlet/singlino cascades yield decay topologies that existing 8 TeV searches did not constrain; Run-2 CMS dedicated searches cover only some of them.
candidate_seeds.signature_hypothesis: Stop pair with many light-flavor jets (>=8-10 jets) plus 0-2 leptons, low MET; gamma-gamma+jets with diphoton mass outside the Higgs window; e-mu+jets; HL-LHC statistics for high-multiplicity tails
